test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L _ _ R _ T _ M P _ S _ _ M P _ S T

options.text: M, P, S, L, R, T, L, R
L, R, T, S, P, P, S, T
L, M, R, S, L, M, P, R
R, P, L, M, S, L, S, T

solution:
Given:- L _ _ R _ T _ M P _ S _ _ M P _ S T

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

**1) M, P, S, L, R, T, L, R →** L **M P** R **S** T - **L** M P **R** S **T - L** M P **R** S T.

Here **"****L M P R S T" is repeated.**

2) L, R, T, S, P, P, S, T → L **L**** R** R **T** T - **S** M P **P** S **P - S** M P **T** S T

3) L, M, R, S, L, M, P, R → L **L** **M** R **R** T - **S** M P **L** S **M - P** M P **R** S T

4) R, P, L, M, S, L, S, T → L ** R**** P** R **L** - T **M** M P **S** S - **L S** M P **T** S T

 
• Option (1) gives pattern of : **L M P R S T** - L M P R S T - **L M P R S T.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"M, P, S, L, R, T, L, R".**
